results.name: Legend of the Seeker
results.overview: The adventures of woodsman Richard Cypher, who discovers that he was born to fulfill a prophecy of becoming a guardian hero to oppressed people. With the help of a mysterious woman named Kahlan and a wise old wizard named Zedd, he must stop a ruthless and bloodthirsty tyrant from unleashing an ancient evil and enslaving the world.

results.name: Treasure Seeking: The Legend of ShenLi
results.original_name: 推市营业中·与凤行专场
results.overview: Shen Li, Xing Zhi, Mo Fang, Fu Rongjun, Tian Jun, and Jin Niangzi receive a task from the celestial realm: to go to Pushi City and capture the demon that has been causing trouble there for three years. The six of them transform into ordinary mortals and arrive in Pushi City, only to find that they have entered the era of the Republic of China. Disguising themselves, they begin their special mission to seal the demon

results.title: Mystery of Muye: The Guardian of the Mountain
results.overview: During the period of the Republic of China, the reclusive descendants of Guanshan Taibao were ordered to investigate a case and solve the mystery of the "Nine Pavilions" of the Qianji Ancient Palace hidden under the mine disaster.

results.title: Mystery of Muye: The Dragon Seeker
Spirit of the Wild
results.overview: A MYSTICAL GRANDFATHER transforms the life of a modern day boy through the legend of SEEKS-TO-HUNT-GREAT. In this haunting and sometimes humorous, SEEKS-TO-HUNT-GREAT (Michael Horse) tracks a mountain lion for many months, learns from it and eventually gains its trust. Struggling to survive the hardships and dangers of living in the wild, both man and lion experience many surprises, and much suspense and adventure.  Based on Native American folklore and the Medicine Wheel Way, SPIRIT OF THE WILD brings an awareness of our important relationship with our environment, our Mother Earth and all our brothers be they two-legged, four-legged or winged.
